⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{目的|もくてき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{達成|たっせい}する→達成：04816_tassei⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: It took a long time, but I was finally able to achieve my objective.

notes:
{目的|もくてき} means purpose or objective - the reason for doing something or what one aims to achieve.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {目的|もくてき}を⟦{達成|たっせい}→達成：04816_tassei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to achieve one's objective
- ⟦{目的|もくてき}{地|ち}→目的地：09996_mokutekichi⟧: destination
- {目的|もくてき}⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧: sense of purpose
- ～を{目的|もくてき}として: with the purpose of ~

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～の{目的|もくてき}は{何|なん}ですか: What is the purpose of ~?
- {目的|もくてき}を⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: with a purpose

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧: goal, target (more concrete/measurable)
- ⟦{狙|ねら}い→狙い：00312_nerai⟧: aim (intention behind an action)
- ⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧: reason (cause rather than aim)
